rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Parts II and IV print every amount in one 8-slot comb per column with no centavo comb, so amounts come from derived:amount_<item><A|B> keys of to_print_field_map: whole pesos (rounded like toFixed(0)), digits only, right-aligned in the comb; an overpayment prints in parentheses; a zero amount, column B of a non-joint return, and an amount wider than the comb stay blank. The address splits over the item 9 combs (40 + 31 slots) at a word break; the date of birth, the page 2 TIN (nine digits), Item 31's two digit boxes and the spouse RDO (blank unless joint) are derived: keys too. Never submitted. Item 19/75's 8% box has no caption in the text layer; it is the second box on that row. Since #113 the Item 63 (specify) input, inset past the caption, prints the description, and the Item 73 cell holds two boxes under one input name, so its xbox_joins name each box by input id (p2c139-i0/-i1). Left blank on print: the TIN branch boxes of Items 4 and 66 and the page 2 TIN comb's last five slots (the sheet preprints 0 0 0 0 0; they are not fillable), the signature block and payment details (Items 32-35, no writer values). The submitted XML always carries every value. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
